status: DRAFT for owner approval. Not used by any run. The frozen full schema is not modified.
full_schema_reference: dataset_v2_batch_001_corrected/schema/final_label_schema.json (read-only; enums, key sets and key order are taken from it at run time)
section_order_note: Order of emission only (higher-risk sections first). Every one of the 18 clinical categories of the full schema is kept; none is removed. Materialisation restores the frozen order.
speaker_field_note: `by` = the role (doctor, patient, nurse, ...) of the person the fact comes from. It is NOT derived from `responsible_person`, which is who must act and stays an explicit model field (`responsible`). When `by` is omitted the backend derives it ONLY if every valid cited segment has the same role; otherwise it stays null and is flagged speaker_unresolved. An explicit `by` always wins and is checked, never changed.
defaults_note: Every other omitted key is null (or [] for list-valued keys). '@by_status' = temporality 'current' when status is 'present', 'resolved' when status is 'resolved'; a past episode must write temporality 'past' explicitly. Every default applied is counted and reported by the materialiser.

symptoms_category_enum.provenance: Not in the frozen schema. Same 13-value list as in the dataset generator blueprint, enforced in the evaluator's schema_validator (see P02 v2.1 plan). Copied here as data; nothing is imported.

reference_policy.ref_format: original transcript segment id exactly as printed in the transcript, e.g. SEG0007. No case folding, no repair.
reference_policy.max_refs_basis: configurable. Default chosen from the reference-count distribution of the 50 corrected dev gold labels (see derived/ref_count_distribution.json): <=4 refs covers 97.4% of facts. The limit only FLAGS (excessive_references); no reference is ever dropped.
reference_policy.prompt_target: 1-2 refs per fact (gold median 2, 90.1% of facts have <=2); a soft instruction, not enforced

derived_by_backend.extraction_status: constant 'completed' once the compact output parsed
derived_by_backend.encounter_metadata: encounter_date null, encounter_type 'outpatient_consultation', language 'en' (the frozen schema's only values); primary_speakers from the transcript speaker table, role lower-cased, role_confidence null
derived_by_backend.clinical_evidence: one record per distinct cited valid segment, in transcript order, EV_001..., supports = fact locations

not_derived.quality_checks: OWNER DECISION PENDING (see STAGE1 report). Materialised records carry no quality_checks key and the evaluator reports it as not assessed.
